description: The bar chart illustrates the number of samples associated with several reasoning categories. The category axis is horizontal, with slanted category labels reading (left to right) “Mathematical Reasoning,” “General Reasoning,” “Natural Scene Reasoning,” a fourth category whose label is partially obscured by a gray overlay (only the ending “...ical” is visible), “Puzzle Reasoning,” and “Chemical Reasoning.” The value axis is vertical and labeled “Number of Samples,” using a logarithmic scale with tick marks shown at approximately \(10^2\), \(10^3\), and \(10^4\). Each category is represented by a single light-blue bar with a black numeric annotation above it: Mathematical Reasoning is labeled 7025, General Reasoning 1709, Natural Scene Reasoning 413, the partially obscured category 232, Puzzle Reasoning 91, and Chemical Reasoning 49. The bars appear arranged from highest to lowest count from left to right, and no additional grouping, stacking, legend, or special emphasis beyond the value labels is shown.
